text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, my next part-time job's at the<n>event hall
nearby, so... I'll see you<n>tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I hear "part-time job," I<n>can't help
thinking back to that recent<n>conversation...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...So, basically, Ines's managers want<n>to show her
how grateful they are for<n>everything she does!
choice_data_list:
And that's why you're planning a thank-you
party?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's going to be totes emosh!<n>Aren't you, like,
dying to lend a hand?
choice_data_list: How did you two end up helping out with this?
How did you two end up helping out with this?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What happened again? Oh yeah, we<n>came by to eat
some ramen and the<n>manager was like, "Are you
guys<n>friends with Fu?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And then—get this! She was like,<n>"Someday I'd love
to reward her for<n>all her hard work."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Facts! So then we said, "Why waitwhen we can do it rn?!" And wefigured all her other managers wouldbe stoked if they could thank her too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, yeah, that's how the whole party<n>idea came
about.
choice_data_list: Okay, what do you want me to do?
Okay, what do you want me to do?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you hype too, Trainer?<n>Yus! Let's make
this the most lit<n>party ever!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, as part of the party prep, I<n>decide to check
out Ines Fujin's<n>work ethic for myself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to take a tiny little peek,<n>that's all. Or at
least, that was the<n>plan, but—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer?! What are you doing<n>here?

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you know this person, Ines? I<n>found them
wandering around the<n>part-time reception area.
Would you<n>mind showing this newbie the ropes?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whaaat! So you are going to workhere? You could've just said, youknow.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While I was scoping out Ines'<n>workplace, I got
mistaken for a<n>worker and brought all the way
here...<n>But I can't exactly admit that to her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're stumped about<n>anything, just come
to me! This<n>venue's kind of special. It's not like<n>at
other events.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, in an effort to witness her<n>work ethic up
close, I start my shift as<n>a member of the event
staff...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The line is now moving forward!<n>Please don't push
while you proceed!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, excuse me! This seat here is<n>available! And it's
a good one—you'll<n>get a clear view of the show!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The food's been delivered, so I laid<n>out all the
dishes!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Whoa, you've even<n>portioned out the food!
That's a huge<n>help!

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text:
It's actually working again! I can't<n>believe how fast
you fixed up this<n>mic!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll use it to deliver some<n>big laughs to the
audience! I'm<n>expecting some killer gags! ♪

text_block_list.name: Team Leader
text_block_list.text:
I can't thank you enough! I heard<n>you're quite the
skilled worker, but<n>you're downright exceptional!
It'd be<n>an honor to have you back sometime!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! I'll come back once my<n>schedule frees
up, so save me some<n>shifts!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Working a shift with Ines Fujin gives<n>me a firm
grasp of both her attentive<n>nature and quickness to
act.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can definitely see why her<n>managers are so
grateful to have her<n>on staff.
choice_data_list: You do a great job of looking out for everyone.
You do a great job of looking out for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks. You weren't half bad<n>yourself,
Trainer. ♪
choice_data_list: What's your secret to working so well?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, my secret... I've never really<n>thought about it
that way. I mean, I<n>think personality comes into it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm guessing that's not the<n>answer you're
looking for, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. If I had to say, I think the secret<n>is to
consider what would make<n>people happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whenever I helped out my mom as akid, she'd be super happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that made me happy too. I<n>remember that fuzzy
feeling in my<n>heart being so comforting, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's when I realized how great it is<n>to make
people happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even now, remembering that feeling<n>helps me do
my best!
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful mindset to have.
That's a wonderful mindset to have.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even now, remembering that feeling<n>helps me do
my best!
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful mindset to have.
That's a wonderful mindset to have.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'd say it practically sums up<n>my whole way
of life!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If you didn't think that was like me,we'd have a problem!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I look at Ines Fujin, she almost<n>appears to be
glowing against the<n>backdrop of the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I know, right?! I think so too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've got my mom to thank for<n>inspiring me! And I
can't thank her<n>enough!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: One day, I really want to repay the<n>favor tenfold. ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We could go to a hidden hot spring<n>deep in the
mountains together—ooh,<n>or a five-star hotel! Wait,
an overseas<n>trip could be nice. Hmm, so many
options!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The excitement in her voice is<n>infectious, and I
can't help but smile<n>as I listen.
